# Handcrafted sprite-gen contract fixture

These original eight RGBA pixels and manifest are handcrafted test data, not AI-generated art and not output from executing sprite-gen. The manifest models the composed contract inspected at aldegad/sprite-gen commit 4f5ccd55c7cf06685a41f954acc1e476b7772ece. No upstream scripts or dependencies are installed.

The fixture intentionally uses non-row-major playback, a repeated rectangle, uneven durations that override conflicting fps metadata, loop and once clips, and alpha values 0, 64, 128 and 255. The manifest object orders differ; row indices determine clip order and arrays determine playback order. The PNG is an original 4 by 2 RGBA8 image, with no external provenance or license claims.
